53	  Present options as plain chat text.

57	  deliverables, not overhead.

59	## 4. Commit and push discipline
60	
61	- Work branch: `claude/handover-reading-vn8zgr`. Never push to a different
62	  branch without explicit permission (the `transcripts` orphan branch was
63	  one explicit exception).
64	- After doc commits and gated-green commits, fast-forward main:
65	  `git push origin claude/handover-reading-vn8zgr:main`.

67	  uncommitted until the gate is green.

69	- Never commit: HANDOVER.md or ZIP contents without Pavol's explicit
70	  go-ahead; copyrighted PDFs and decks (`research/decks/` is gitignored —
71	  reference by Wayback URL, never commit the PDF); model identifiers in any
72	  committed artifact.

74	  quotations, never document reproductions.
75	- Generated-source churn is a regression to investigate, not noise to

92	  or gated changes exist.

95	
96	- Delegate by default. The main session does high-level coordination; bulk
97	  reads, transcript recovery, and big searches go to worker agents.
98	  Compacting instead of delegating is a failure mode Pavol has called out.
99	- A "Scout" is a delegated research agent sent out with a written brief:
100	  state the audience, the question, and cross-reference earlier session
101	  research so it doesn't rediscover known ground.
